title: CAD/CAM-guided total condylar remodelling for the management of active mandibular condylar hyperplasia
html: The purpose was to describe a novel computer-aided design/computer-aided manufacturing (CAD/CAM)-guided surgical technique for the management of active mandibular condylar hyperplasia (CH) based on virtual surgical planning (VSP), incorporating combined proximal and lateral condylar remodelling to optimise condyle–fossa adaptation, occlusal relationships, and facial symmetry. The proposed technique integrates three-dimensional imaging, VSP, and patient-specific CAD/CAM cutting guides. Unlike conventional high or proportional condylectomy, the approach includes a planned lateral reduction of condylar width in addition to proximal condylar resection.
